payload.explanation: The diagnostic report traces the lock chain: the business request session_8a0efe7bea9c is blocked, ultimately by root blocker session_afc899ddc297, an idle-in-transaction session holding an uncommitted UPDATE on inventory. The state report confirms session_afc899ddc297 is eligible for rollback_session and the business request must not be modified directly. Rolling back the eligible root blocker resolves the contention while preserving the business request and unrelated transactions.
